requests.reply: {"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "At dawn, the mist outside the sect gate had not yet lifted."}, {"id": 1, "text": "Yunzhou, you're finally back. Did you bring enough qi stones?"}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "I brought three sacks, all of the best from the back mountain."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "The ward cracked another seam last night, and Elder Qín didn't sleep a wink."}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Before the words had fully left his mouth, Mòqí Jìng came racing up from the foot of the mountain."}, {"id": 1, "text": "Gasping for breath, he said that a young woman was lying by the road at the foot of the mountain."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Bring her up quickly. Ruoshui, go fetch the healing pills."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Wan Qi Jing carried the unconscious woman into the hall, the iron tag at his waist engraved: Qiu Shuang."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "It's not serious, she's just run out of spiritual energy. Feed her one Spirit-Restoring Pill and she'll be fine."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Senior Sister Zeng, Elder Qin wants you at the ward; Brother Moqi and I will stay here."}, {"id": 1, "text": "Alright. If Miss Qiu wakes up, come get me right away."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Wan Qi Jing scratched his head and turned to run toward the foot of the mountain again."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Xiè Xuán stood at the hall doorway, her sword still sheathed, yet the lamplight dimmed for a moment."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Elder Qín, I trust you are well. By the pavilion master's order, I have come to collect three tenths of the qi stones."}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Three parts? The qi stones were hoarded by our sect through hard labor. When has an outsider ever been entitled to take them?"}, {"id": 1, "text": "The ward has already cracked, and keeping the qi stones in your hands is not safe. I will return in three days."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Xiè Xuán sneered and turned to leave without looking back."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "I said three days, and three days it will be. I never break my word."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Elder Qín stroked his beard and glanced at Chóu Shuāng, who lay asleep on the couch."}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Elder, let me go and guard the ward. Miss Chou has Yuè Chuān looking after her, so I can be spared."}, {"id": 1, "text": "At last he nodded and took a jade talisman from his sleeve."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "This is the array-eye token. Hold it, and you have held your path."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Yue Chuan stuffed the medicine pouch into Yun Zhou's arms and murmured a few more instructions."}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "At the mountain gate, Wan Qi Jing handed over a straw raincoat."}, {"id": 1, "text": "Thank you, Senior Brother Wan. Miss Qiu has woken up, please convey my thanks to her."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Dan Yunzhou nodded and tucked the formation-eye token close to his body."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "In the hall, Qiu Shuang slowly opened her eyes."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Good that you're awake. You've been unconscious for a whole day, so don't move around ▼"}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Qiu Shuang struggled to sit up and looked toward the cracked sky beyond the window."}, {"id": 1, "text": "No one noticed that the letter in her sleeve bore Xie Xuan's seal."}]}

translations.1: At dawn, the mist outside the sect gate had not yet lifted.
translations.10: Senior Sister Zeng, Elder Qin wants you at the ward; Brother Moqi and I will stay here.
translations.11: Alright. If Miss Qiu wakes up, come get me right away.
translations.12: Wan Qi Jing scratched his head and turned to run toward the foot of the mountain again.
translations.13: Xiè Xuán stood at the hall doorway, her sword still sheathed, yet the lamplight dimmed for a moment.
translations.14: Elder Qín, I trust you are well. By the pavilion master's order, I have come to collect three tenths of the qi stones.
translations.15: Three parts? The qi stones were hoarded by our sect through hard labor. When has an outsider ever been entitled to take them?
translations.16: The ward has already cracked, and keeping the qi stones in your hands is not safe. I will return in three days.
translations.17: Xiè Xuán sneered and turned to leave without looking back.
translations.18: I said three days, and three days it will be. I never break my word.
translations.19: Elder Qín stroked his beard and glanced at Chóu Shuāng, who lay asleep on the couch.
translations.2: Yunzhou, you're finally back. Did you bring enough qi stones?
translations.20: Elder, let me go and guard the ward. Miss Chou has Yuè Chuān looking after her, so I can be spared.
translations.21: At last he nodded and took a jade talisman from his sleeve.
translations.22: This is the array-eye token. Hold it, and you have held your path.
translations.23: Yue Chuan stuffed the medicine pouch into Yun Zhou's arms and murmured a few more instructions.
translations.24: At the mountain gate, Wan Qi Jing handed over a straw raincoat.
translations.25: Thank you, Senior Brother Wan. Miss Qiu has woken up, please convey my thanks to her.
translations.26: Dan Yunzhou nodded and tucked the formation-eye token close to his body.
translations.27: In the hall, Qiu Shuang slowly opened her eyes.
translations.28: Good that you're awake. You've been unconscious for a whole day, so don't move around ▼
translations.29: Qiu Shuang struggled to sit up and looked toward the cracked sky beyond the window.
translations.3: I brought three sacks, all of the best from the back mountain.
translations.30: No one noticed that the letter in her sleeve bore Xie Xuan's seal.
translations.4: The ward cracked another seam last night, and Elder Qín didn't sleep a wink.
translations.5: Before the words had fully left his mouth, Mòqí Jìng came racing up from the foot of the mountain.
translations.6: Gasping for breath, he said that a young woman was lying by the road at the foot of the mountain.
translations.7: Bring her up quickly. Ruoshui, go fetch the healing pills.
translations.8: Wan Qi Jing carried the unconscious woman into the hall, the iron tag at his waist engraved: Qiu Shuang.
translations.9: It's not serious, she's just run out of spiritual energy. Feed her one Spirit-Restoring Pill and she'll be fine.
